1: There's a man at my job who keeps a photo of his kids taped inside his lunch box.
2: He sees it every day at noon. Nobody has to remind him who he's working for.
3: Thy word have I hid in mine heart,
4: that I might not sin against thee.
6: David didn't say he read the Word. He said he hid it, where nobody can take it.
7: You only hide what you can't afford to lose. That's what the Word is to a man.
8: Temptation doesn't call ahead. The verse you already know is the one that shows up in time.
9: One verse in your heart beats a whole Bible on the shelf.
10: Today, carry this verse. Say it at the red light, on the line, until it's yours.
11: Let's pray. Father, hide Your Word deep in us, where the day can't shake it loose.
12: When temptation comes, bring Your Word back to our minds before we move.
13: Keep our hearts clean before You. In Jesus' name, amen.
14: Follow Blessed Prayers so the Word finds you on the hard days. Drop an amen.
15: Hide the Word for today in your heart. Have a blessed day.
